# Work Submission

My assignments and labs are always posted on Omnivox but submiited via [Gradescope.ca](https://www.gradescope.ca/courses/39225)

- Login with your student id email: `123456@johnabbott.qc.ca`
- You might need to set the password if logging-in for the first time. 

# Every week

:::{.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true" title="📚 Before class - Preparation ~ 1 hour"}

**Goal: Arrive prepared to learn and practice.**

* Read the notes of this week's topic and go over the examples
* Complete the **Test Myself** questions.
* Try the practice problems on your own.
* Prepare as if you will have a **short paper quiz** on a weekly basis. 

:::



:::{.callout-tip icon="false" collapse="true"  title="💻 In class - 3 hours"}

**Goal: Practice, apply, and deepen your understanding.**

* Ask questions and clarification on the content
  * Sometimes a recap or demo will be done by the teacher 
* ✏️ Complete a short **paper quiz/check** on the preparation material.
* Work through guided programming exercises or evaluated labs at your own pace or in groups of 2.
* Finish with a recap to check your understanding.

:::




::: {.callout-important icon="false" collapse="true"  title= "🚀 After class - Homework ~2 hours"}

**Goal: Consolidate your learning and stay on pace.**	

* You must complete the Lab/Assignment started in class
* Review anything from today's class that you found difficult.
* Then, prepare for the upcoming week.

:::
